Expectancy in $ per oz after ENG costs (development in 4,000-equivalent dollars). Neither = timeout or closure. Risk of ruin: bootstrap of the development trades, 2,000 paths of 250 trades at 0.50 lot (ASSUMED 100 oz).

### Risk audit: assumptions (identical for every candidate; NOT verified broker outcomes)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Starting balance / currency | $100,000 USD (ASSUMED) |
| Contract size | 100 oz per 1.00 lot (ASSUMED; broker specification not supplied) |
| Position | fixed 0.50 lot = 50 oz = $50 per $1 move (ASSUMED contract) |
| Spread (ENG) | $0.30 per oz in session, $0.50 off session (modelled, not measured) |
| Slippage (ENG) | $0.20 per oz on entry; $0.20 per oz on every exit except a filled target |
| Commission (ENG) | $0.07 per oz ($7 per 1.00 lot, ASSUMED) |
| Cost stress | ADV − ENG added per trade: + one more spread, + $0.20 entry and + $0.20 exit slippage |
| Concurrency | one position at a time (the independent series); no pyramiding, no compounding, no other exposure |
| Drawdown | peak-to-trough of cumulative P&L from the start; over 250 trades |
| Simulation | 2,000 bootstrap paths per scenario; 95% interval of the iid figure from a nested bootstrap (200 outer resamples of the trade pool x 200 paths); block bootstrap = circular blocks of 10 trades |
| Thresholds | $2,500 / $5,000 / $10,000 = 2.5% / 5% / 10% of the ASSUMED balance (the 10% figure is the ruin line) |
